title: Trainingpeaks Metric1 Hour-of-Day Pattern

app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trainingpeaks:metric1
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")

description: Shows which hours of the day trainingpeaks metric1 (1) events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on trainingpeaks metric1 (1) events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It finds what time of day your trainingpeaks metric1 (1) feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
